guards: Secret(vault_key='demo_key', message='API key', kind='password', default=None, generate=False)
unit:
[Unit]
Description=Demo service
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/srv/demo/current
Environment="MODE=prod"
Environment="DEMO_HOST=<vault:demo_host>"
ExecStart=uv run --no-sync demo serve --host ${DEMO_HOST}
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
